title: Nerv Hooks Configuration
description: Schema for hooks.yaml — user-authored hook definitions. Mode 1 (exec) only; HTTP/gRPC modes ship as marketplace forwarder handlers, not spec modes.

hook_defaults.description: Default values applied to all hooks unless overridden.

timeout.description: Default timeout in seconds for hook execution.

on_error.description: Default error handling: continue processing or abort.

parallel.description: Whether hooks for the same event run in parallel by default.

name.description: Human-readable hook name. Must be unique within the file.

on.description: Event name(s) that trigger this hook. Single string or array.

match.description: Regex pattern to filter by tool name. Applied only to tool-category events (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, etc.).

run.description: Path to executable handler. Receives nerv envelope on stdin; writes decision JSON to stdout. Mode 1 (exec) only.

require_capability.description: Skip this hook if the active CLI adapter lacks this capability. Value is an event name or adapter feature identifier.

parallel.description: Run this hook in parallel with other hooks for the same event. Overrides defaults.parallel.

requires.description: Feature flags this hook needs. e.g. ["full_payload"] to opt out of payload redaction.

disabled.description: When true, the dispatcher short-circuits this entry and emits {decision: skipped, reason: disabled} to the event log. Daemon enforcement lands separately. Event-level and binding-level disables live in the .nerv/disabled.yaml sidecar — see schemas/disabled/1.0-draft.

exit_code_map.description: Maps handler exit codes to nerv decisions. Keys are exit code integers (as strings). Values are decision strings.
